<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/navigation.ts -->
<!--
  A footer with the brand, a tagline, groups of links and the copyright. Axes: layout (columns: brand above,
  equal columns per group, row: the brand, the group names and the copyright in one row), signup mode (none,
  first: a sign-up above the links), status mode (none, show: a live status pill), density. The live status
  itself is a port contract.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { FooterSignup, FooterStatus } from "./sitemap-footer.types";
  import type { MegaGroup } from "./mega-menu.types";

  export type SitemapFooterProps = {
    label: string;
    brand: string;
    tagline: string;
    copyright: string;
    groups: MegaGroup[];
    signup?: FooterSignup;
    status?: FooterStatus;
    id?: string;
    layout?: "columns" | "row" | "card";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Container from "../primitives/container/container.svelte";
  import Form from "../primitives/form/form.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Input from "../primitives/input/input.svelte";
  import Label from "../primitives/label/label.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import FooterCard from "../components/footer-card.svelte";
  import FooterColumns from "../components/footer-columns.svelte";
  import Pill from "../components/pill.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    label,
    brand,
    tagline,
    copyright,
    groups,
    signup,
    status,
    id = "footer",
    layout = "columns",
    density = "default",
  }: SitemapFooterProps = $props();
</script>

{#if ((layout as string) === "card")}
  <FooterCard label={label} brand={brand} groups={groups} />
{:else}
  <Block tag="footer" class="mt-12 border-t border-border" data-testid="site-footer" data-layout={layout}>
    <Container
      class={cn(
        "mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4",
        "flex flex-col gap-8",
        (((density as string) === "compact") ? "py-6" : "py-12")
      )}
      data-slot="container"
    >
      {#if (signup?.mode === "first")}
        <Stack gap="4" class="max-w-md" data-testid="signup">
          <Title as={3} size="xl" weight="bold">
            {signup?.title}
          </Title>
          <Form class={cn("w-full max-w-md", (false ? "mx-auto" : ""))} data-testid="email-form">
            <Label for={tpl("{0}-email", id)} class="sr-only">
              {signup?.label}
            </Label>
            <Group gap="2" align="start" class="w-full flex-wrap">
              <Input type="email" name="email" class="min-w-0 flex-1" id={tpl("{0}-email", id)} data-testid="field" />
              <Button variant="default" size="default" type="button" data-testid="submit">
                {signup?.submit}
              </Button>
            </Group>
          </Form>
        </Stack>
      {/if}
      {#if ((layout as string) === "columns")}
        <Box class="flex flex-col gap-8 md:flex-row md:items-start md:gap-12" data-slot="footer-top">
          <Stack gap="2" class="md:w-64 md:shrink-0">
            <Text size="xl" weight="bold">
              {brand}
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {tagline}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <Box class="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <FooterColumns label={label} groups={groups} />
          </Box>
        </Box>
      {:else}
        <Group gap="6" align="center" justify="between" class="flex-wrap">
          <Text size="base" weight="bold">
            {brand}
          </Text>
          <Block tag="nav" aria-label={label}>
            <Group gap="4" class="flex-wrap">
              {#each groups as g (g.id)}
                <Link href="#/" variant="default" class="text-sm" data-testid="group">
                  {g.title}
                </Link>
              {/each}
            </Group>
          </Block>
        </Group>
      {/if}
      <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between" class="flex-wrap border-t border-border pt-6">
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {copyright}
        </Text>
        {#if (status?.mode === "show")}
          <Pill tone="green" icon="circle-check">
            {status?.label}
          </Pill>
        {/if}
      </Group>
    </Container>
  </Block>
{/if}
